error.guidance: DAE construction turns the flat model into equations plus unknowns and checks that the two counts agree (MLS §4.9). An unbalanced model is usually a declared variable with no equation to determine it, or one equation too many. This check runs *before* structural analysis, so a missing equation is reported here rather than as a structural singularity.
